info.about: Drakengard 2, known in Japan as Drag-On Dragoon 2: Sealed Red, Immoral Black, is a 2005 action role-playing video game developed by Cavia and published by Square Enix in Japan and Ubisoft in all other territories for the PlayStation 2. It is the second entry in the Drakengard series, set after the events of the original Drakengard.
